about: Engine features EngineWire.Build.cs detects from the engine's own files, never from a version number. A row is present when the first of its paths that exists (file or folder, relative to the Engine folder) holds its marker text, or exists at all when it has no marker. A row with "define": true becomes MCP_HAS_<name> (1 or 0) for the C++, in place of an engine-version test.
